timeline.a: silent. A plume of golden sand bursts out of the bowl over the lens
she flops on her back in the bowl, thrashing all four paws, sand sheeting past the lens
she rockets upright out of the sand, coat blazing, sand pouring off her
she shakes her body once, hard, a ring of golden dust bursting through the lens
she hauls the coin up and slams it flat over the lens, blacking the frame
the coin drops away, she is tiny and far off, sea filling the window
she rolls the coin on edge straight at the camera, running behind it, till it fills the frame
she heaves the coin over her head into the bowl, a plume twice her size over the lens
she scrambles up the bowl rim and launches off it at the camera, all four paws flying
she lands and walks into the lens till her head fills the whole frame
one enormous eye and the crown, the eye rolling to the lens, a sun glint sweeping across
voiceless now. She hurls herself backwards into the bowl, a huge plume over the lens
the frame is solid glowing gold, her tail whipping past the lens and gone
she erupts out of the sand and shakes once, hard, a ring of golden dust past the lens
she lifts the crown off, huffs on it and buffs it on her belly fur till it flares
she flicks the crown back on and kicks a last spray of sand at the lens
